articles.title: MPL Malaysia Season 18 brings Playoffs fever nationwide—celebrating esports at the heart of Malaysian culture!
articles.description: Malaysia's biggest esports showdown is set to return with a nationwide celebration of esports, entertainment, and local traditions as the Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Professional League (MPL) Malaysia Season 18 Playoffs take over Stadium Juara, Kuala Lumpur, from 28 October to 1 November.

articles.title: Thailand takes its next step toward the MCT SEA and the M8 as Leon Esports wins MSL Thailand Season 2
articles.description: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) Super League Thailand (MSL TH) Season 2 has concluded, with Leon Esports (LEON) crowned champion before a sold-out crowd at BCC Hall, Central Ladprao, Bangkok, Thailand.

articles.title: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang celebrates 10th anniversary across 10 countries as it charts the future of its global journey
articles.description: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) marked its 10th anniversary with simultaneous celebrations across 10 countries from 9 to 11 October, drawing tens of thousands of fans to events spanning Asia, Europe, and Latin America. Held under the theme "ALL IN MLBB", the celebrations brought MLBB's heroes, communities, and culture to life, marking a decade of growth shaped by its players.

articles.title: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang celebrates 10 years on Istanbul's Bosphorus Strait, bridging East and West ahead of M8 World Championship
articles.description: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) celebrated its 10th anniversary on Istanbul's Bosphorus this past weekend, bringing together hundreds of players and creators from across Türkiye. The celebration marked a decade of growth for one of the world's most popular mobile games, while setting the stage for the M8 World Championship (M8) in January 2027. The tournament will be the first M Series held in Europe.

articles.title: Malaysia's MLBB community takes centre stage at the 10th Anniversary Carnival in Kuching
articles.description: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) put its Malaysian community at the heart of its 10th anniversary celebrations with #Karnival10BersamaMLBB, held at Vivacity Megamall, Kuching, from 9 to 11 October.

articles.title: MOONTON Games Brings MLBB's 10-Year Milestone to Surabaya as It Looks to the Next Decade
articles.description: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) marked its 10th anniversary in Surabaya from 9-11 October with the ALL IN MLBB 10th Anniversary Festival, bringing players, communities, and the developer team together for a celebration rooted in player connection.

articles.title: MLBB goes ALL IN with Filipino players to celebrate 10 years together—and look ahead to the next chapter
articles.description: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) celebrated 10 years of growing alongside Filipino players, communities, creators, and esports talent through a four-day flagship activation at Market! Market! in Bonifacio Global City from 8 to 11 October.

articles.title: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang successfully concludes historic Asian Games debut as Myanmar claims inaugural gold at Aichi-Nagoya 2026
articles.description: Myanmar have been crowned champions of the 2026 Asian Games Esports Events: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB), defeating Indonesia 4-0 in the Grand Final at Aichi Sky Expo.

articles.title: MPL Philippines Season 18 Playoffs heads to PhilSports Arena, marking a major milestone in MLBB's 10th anniversary
articles.description: The Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) Professional League Philippines (MPL PH) Season 18 Playoffs will take centre stage at PhilSports Arena in Pasig City, from 21-25 October 2026. This marks a defining moment for Philippine esports as the country's leading professional mobile esports league brings its biggest matches to one of the nation's most recognised sporting venues.

articles.title: Visa, MOONTON Games extend collaboration with new three-year partnership for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang's M Series–the world's most watched mobile esports tournament
articles.description: Visa, a global leader in digital payments, and MOONTON Games, the international video game developer behind Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB), today announced a three-year partnership to elevate the M Series experience for fans worldwide. The partnership sees Visa named the Global Payment Partner for the next three editions of the M Series—the M8 World Championship (M8) in 2027 through the M10 World Championship (M10)

articles.title: MLBB Asian Games Main Stage Group Draw revealed as teams begin final road to Aichi-Nagoya
articles.description: The Group Draw for the 2026 Asian Games Esports Events: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) has been revealed, setting the final road to medal contention in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.
